quote: Harmonic Announces IMO Gold Medal-Level Performance & Launch of First Mathematical Superintelligence (MSI) AI App
kind_note: AI application (iOS app / web app / API)
note: Aristotle is a Mathematical Superintelligence (MSI) application built by Harmonic, a startup founded by former Robinhood CEO Baiju Bhatt. The system was initially released as an iOS app with waitlist on July 28, 2025, with rollout commencing that day. It is available across iOS, Android, web, and API. The classification as 'harness' in the original request is incorrect; Aristotle is a shipped AI application product, not a harness or orchestration system.
